prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case, the severity of injuries, and what you need (negotiation vs. trial, medical support, resources for catastrophic care, etc.). That said, here’s how to find the best attorney for your situation in Chicago and what to look for.

How to choose
- Experience with car-accident cases and similar injuries (soft-tissue vs. catastrophic/wrongful death).  
- Trial experience and a record of verdicts/settlements if the insurer won’t offer fair compensation.  
- Resources: access to medical experts, accident reconstruction, and staff to handle discovery.  
- Local court knowledge and relationships with judges/defense counsel can help.  
- Communication: responsive, explains strategy and fees in plain language.  
- Contingency-fee arrangement and clear explanation of costs/percentages.  
- Positive client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, AVVO, Martindale-Hubbell).  

Where to look
- Illinois State Bar Association Lawyer Referral / find-a-lawyer tools.  
- Super Lawyers (Illinois/Chicago lists).  
- Martindale-Hubbell and AVVO for ratings and client reviews.  
- Local trial-lawyer groups and newspapers that report large verdicts/settlements.  

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar amount.  
- Reluctance to put fee agreement in writing.  
- Poor communication during the free consult.  
- Firms that handle thousands of unrelated practice areas (look for firms that specialize in injury).

What to bring to an initial consultation
- Police report, photos of the crash/scene/vehicle damage, medical records/bills, insurance info, names/contact info of witnesses, correspondence with insurers, dates of treatment, and a timeline of the crash and injuries.

Questions to ask in a consult
- How many car-accident cases do you handle per year?  
- Have you tried cases similar to mine? What were the outcomes?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?  
- What is your fee and how are costs handled?  
- What’s your strategy for my case and expected timeline?

Reputable Chicago firms (examples)
- Clifford Law Offices — long-established Chicago firm known for serious injury and wrongful-death cases.  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. — well-known in Chicago for high-value personal-injury work.

(If you want, I can compile a shortlist of highly rated Chicago car-accident attorneys with contact info and recent case results — tell me your neighborhood or the part of Chicago you’re in, severity of injuries, and whether you prefer a large firm or a smaller boutique practice.)
